title: new-determinant-split-restriction
statement:
theorem determinant_split_comparison_restriction {X : Scheme.{v}}
    (S : ShortComplex X.Modules) (r₁ r₂ r₃ : ℕ) (_hr : r₂ = r₁ + r₃)
    [S.X₁.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank r₁] [S.X₃.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank r₃]
    (V : X.Opens) (d : ∀ (W : X.Opens), W ≤ V →
      (exteriorSheaf S.X₁ r₁ ⊗ exteriorSheaf S.X₃ r₃).val.obj (op W)
        ≃ₗ[X.presheaf.obj (op W)] (exteriorSheaf S.X₂ r₂).val.obj (op W))
    (d₀ : ∀ (W : X.Opens), W ≤ V →
      (exteriorSheaf S.X₁ r₁ ⊗ exteriorSheaf S.X₃ r₃).val.obj (op W)
        →ₗ[X.presheaf.obj (op W)] (exteriorSheaf S.X₂ r₂).val.obj (op W))
    (hn : ∀ (W Z : X.Opens) (hW : W ≤ V) (hZW : Z ≤ W) y,
      (exteriorSheaf S.X₂ r₂).val.map (homOfLE hZW).op (d₀ W hW y) =
        d₀ Z (hZW.trans hW)
          ((exteriorSheaf S.X₁ r₁ ⊗ exteriorSheaf S.X₃ r₃).val.map
            (homOfLE hZW).op y))
    (hd : ∀ W hW y, d W hW y = d₀ W hW y) :
    ∀ (W Z : X.Opens) (hW : W ≤ V) (hZW : Z ≤ W) y,
      (exteriorSheaf S.X₂ r₂).val.map (homOfLE hZW).op (d W hW y) =
        d Z (hZW.trans hW)
          ((exteriorSheaf S.X₁ r₁ ⊗ exteriorSheaf S.X₃ r₃).val.map
            (homOfLE hZW).op y)

proof.text: For every W, Z and section y, substitute the assumed pointwise equality of d with the natural linear family d₀ on both sides. The resulting equation is exactly the naturality hypothesis hn. No generation or lift compatibility argument is needed.

proof_origin.place: local construction; naturality preserved when linear maps are converted to equal equivalences, repair of reviewer X-3eef1

theorem determinant_split_comparison_restriction {X : Scheme.{v}}
    (S : ShortComplex X.Modules) (r₁ r₂ r₃ : ℕ) (hr : r₂ = r₁ + r₃)

        ≃ₗ[X.presheaf.obj (op W)] (exteriorSheaf S.X₂ r₂).val.obj (op W))
    (c : ∀ (W : X.Opens), W ≤ V →
      (Fin r₃ → S.X₃.val.obj (op W)) → Fin r₃ → S.X₂.val.obj (op W))
    (hd : ∀ W hW (a : Fin r₁ → S.X₁.val.obj (op W))
      (b : Fin r₃ → S.X₃.val.obj (op W)),
      d W hW (tmulSection (exteriorSheafSection S.X₁ r₁ W a)
        (exteriorSheafSection S.X₃ r₃ W b)) =
      exteriorSheafSection S.X₂ r₂ W
        (fun i ↦ Fin.append (fun j ↦ S.f.val.app (op W) (a j))
          (fun j ↦ c W hW b j) (Fin.cast hr i))) :
    ∀ (W Z : X.Opens) (hW : W ≤ V) (hZW : Z ≤ W) y,
      (exteriorSheaf S.X₂ r₂).val.map (homOfLE hZW).op (d W hW y) =
        d Z (hZW.trans hW)
          ((exteriorSheaf S.X₁ r₁ ⊗ exteriorSheaf S.X₃ r₃).val.map
            (homOfLE hZW).op y)
statement_change.what: The old arbitrary tuple family c does not imply restriction compatibility: on Spec(Q[t]) with ranks (0,1,1), take d_X=id and d_W=2 id for proper subopens, and c_W=d_W. Replace c and its generator equation by a natural linear family d₀ and pointwise equality d=d₀. The corrected theorem is proved by substitution; the caller retains the naturality provided by the linear construction.
